europe_now.title: Ukraine launches large-scale drone attacks on Russia
europe_now.summary: Ukraine has conducted one of its largest drone attacks on Russian territory, targeting multiple regions. Russian officials report casualties and infrastructure damage from the strikes.

europe_now.title: Greek island wildfires cause deaths and mass evacuation
europe_now.summary: Twin fires erupted on a Greek island, resulting in two fatalities and the evacuation of hundreds of residents. Emergency services are working to contain the blazes amid extreme heat conditions.
